name: Channel Hints
description: Injects channel-specific format and capability hints into the agent system prompt based on the active messaging channel (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Signal, WeChat, etc.).

enabled.description: Enable channel-specific format hints injection (default: true)

customHints.description: Custom channel hints to add or override built-in hints. Keys are channelId strings, values are hint text strings.
